VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Liberty Gold Corp. (TSX:LGD; OTCQX:LGDTF) ("Liberty Gold" or the “Company”), is pleased to announce its financial and operating results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. All amounts are presented in United States dollars unless otherwise stated.

THIRD QUARTER OF 2026 AND RECENT HIGHLIGHTS

PROJECT HIGHLIGHTS – BLACK PINE

During 2026, Liberty Gold advanced the Black Pine Gold Project (“Black Pine” or the “Project”) through resource growth, completion of a feasibility study, and key federal permitting milestones, while also executing strategic corporate initiatives.

  • On September 8, 2026, we announced the Black Pine Feasibility Study (“FS”) with a $2.4 billion Net Present Value (“NPV”)(5%) and 60% Internal Rate of Return (“IRR”) at $3,250 per ounce (“oz”) gold (“Au”) (after-tax)1. The FS establishes Black Pine as a large-scale, long-life oxide gold development project based on a technically straightforward, open-pit, run-of-mine (“ROM”) heap-leach operation requiring no ore crushing, screening or agglomeration. The FS supports average annual payable Au production of 202,000 oz in Years 1-5 from a 4.04 million oz Au Probable Mineral Reserve, with an initial capital cost of $411.4 million and strong economic returns across a broad range of gold prices2.
  • On October 27, 20263, we announced advancement toward construction readiness through the commencement of detailed engineering with M3 Engineering & Technology Corporation and NewFields Companies LLC and secured fabrication capacity for key long-lead electrical infrastructure and gold recovery equipment.
  • On October 22, 20264, we reported initial drill results from the drill program, highlights include:
    • Drilling defined a 200 meter (“m”) x 400m northern extension to the oxide gold mineralization at Rangefront with grades above current reserve cutoff. Mineralization remains open to the north.
    • Approximately 25 to 35 million tonnes of inferred material above resource cutoff has been targeted for resource classification upgrade.
      • Intercept Highlights:
      • LBP1341A: 0.42 g/t Au over 62.5 m Including 0.63 g/t Au over 15.2 m,
      • LBP1347: 0.36 g/t Au over 144.8 m Including 1.27 g/t Au over 18.3 m, and
      • LBP1293: 0.30 g/t Au over 91.4 m Including 0.54 g/t Au over 9.1 m.
    • Mineralized material above reserve cutoff has been defined throughout the Legacy Rock Storage Facility
      • Intercept Highlights:
      • BP26BF_CD039: 0.86 g/t Au over 59.4 m, and
      • BP26BF_A029: 0.29 g/t Au over 38.1 m.
  • On September 17, 20265, we reported results from the Phase 6 metallurgical test program that used bulk column leaching intended to simulate gold leach performance within a commercial ROM heap. The results continued to support feasibility study assumptions, confirming that gold recoveries are largely insensitive to particle size, validating modeled ROM recoveries, demonstrating rapid leach kinetics, and supporting projected reagent consumption and operating cost estimates. Permeability testing results further supported heap leach design assumptions, with six of seven run-of-mine samples demonstrating adequate solution percolation and reinforcing the effectiveness of planned ore blending strategies.
  • On August 5, 20266, we announced the submission of a Preliminary Design Report to initiate the Idaho cyanidation permitting process to the Idaho Department of Environmental Quality and disclosed that Liberty Gold is a member of the International Cyanide Management Institute and signatory to the International Cyanide Management Code.

CORPORATE HIGHLIGHTS

  • On November 3, 2026, we announced the appointment of Craig Dudra to our Board of Directors, effective December 1, 2026.
  • On October 5, 20267, we announced the appointment of Curtis Cadwell as General Manager for Black Pine.
  • On October 1, 20268, we announced the receipt of the final staged payment of $2.6 million from the sale of the TV Tower project in Türkiye.
  • On September 15, 2026, we announced our inclusion in the MVIS® Global Junior Gold Miners Index effective September 18, 2026. The Index is the underlying benchmark for the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (“GDXJ”), which seeks to replicate, as closely as possible, the price and yield performance of the Index.

WARREN, Ohio, Nov. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Avalon Holdings Corporation (NYSE Amex: AWX) today announced financial results for the third quarter of 2026.

Net operating revenues in the third quarter of 2026 were $24.3 million compared with $25.7 million in the third quarter of 2025. The Company recorded net income attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $2.7 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared with net income attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $1.9 million in the third quarter of 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, basic net income per share attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders was $0.69 compared with basic net income per share attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $0.49 in the third quarter of 2025.

For the first nine months of 2026, net operating revenues were $62.9 million compared with $62.1 million for the first nine months of 2025. The Company recorded a net income attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of approximately $2.3 million in the first nine months of 2026 compared with net income attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $0.7 million in the first nine months of 2025. For the first nine months of 2026, basic net income per share attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders was $0.60 compared with basic net income per share attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $0.17 in the first nine months of 2025.

Avalon Holdings Corporation provides waste management services to industrial, commercial, municipal and governmental customers in selected northeastern and midwestern U.S. markets, captive landfill management services and salt water injection well operations. Avalon Holdings Corporation also owns Avalon Resorts and Clubs Inc., which includes the operation of a hotel and its associated resort amenities, four golf courses and related country clubs and a multipurpose recreation center.

The revised schedule is intended to allow the Company to focus on making its investor communications more substantive, valuable and engaging. By concentrating its live discussions around the Q2 and year-end results, the Company expects to provide more in-depth commentary on its financial performance, business strategy and outlook, while creating greater opportunities for meaningful engagement with investors and analysts. The revised schedule is also consistent with the Company’s ongoing efforts to manage expenses and operate efficiently. Earnings calls are a voluntary practice for publicly traded companies and are not mandated by securities regulations. The Company may reinstitute quarterly calls at any time and may also provide alternative communications during periods when no calls are scheduled, including CEO video updates or presentations.

PyroGenesis leverages 35 years of plasma technology leadership to deliver advanced engineering solutions to energy, propulsion, destruction, process heating, emissions, and materials development challenges across heavy industry and defense. Its customers include global leaders in aluminum, aerospace, steel, iron ore, utilities, environmental services, military, and government. From its Montreal headquarters and local manufacturing facilities, PyroGenesis’ engineers, scientists, and technicians drive innovation and commercialization of energy transition and ultra-high temperature technology. WEST PALM BEACH, FL / ACCESS Newswire / November 6, 2026 / The Search for Future Battery Materials

From electric vehicles to stationary energy storage, lithium-ion batteries play a central role in a changing energy landscape. That makes the location, availability and economics of future lithium supply important questions for the battery and transportation industries.

ELEKTROS Inc. (OTC PINK:ELEK), publicly traded on the OTC market, is assessing a potential hard-rock lithium opportunity in northern New York, near the Canadian border. The company's review remains at an early exploratory stage. No property acquisition has been completed or announced, and no independently verified mineral resource or reserve-or economic development case-has been established.

A U.S. Location, a Due-Diligence Process

The possibility of a domestic source is one reason the company is taking a closer look. If geological work, mineral rights, infrastructure, permitting and project economics support development, the property could potentially offer a U.S.-based supply option for processors and other battery-material participants.

At this stage, however, no commercial-scale lithium occurrence or project advantage has been demonstrated. The company must establish whether lithium is present in commercially meaningful quantities and whether a project could be responsibly permitted, developed and financed.

Industry Outlook Highlights the Scale of the Opportunity-and the Work Ahead

In an October 22, 2026 article titled "Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat," Benzinga referenced a Benchmark Mineral Intelligence outlook that global lithium demand could more than triple by 2050. The outlook described a possible requirement for 134 new mines and more than $100 billion of investment, with demand supported by electric vehicles and stationary energy storage.

These figures describe a broad industry outlook, not an ELEKTROS forecast. They do not establish the mineral content, potential production, value or commercial prospects of the property under review. The article referenced companies other than ELEKTROS.

Patent Initiative Remains Distinct from Lithium Review

Separately, ELEKTROS continues to explore potential development relationships involving its multi-port EV charging patent, U.S. Patent No. 12,522,100 B1. The company considers the patent initiative and the northern New York lithium assessment to be distinct areas of interest.

No completed charging prototype, patent license, customer deployment, adoption milestone or related revenue is being announced in this release.

The Next Steps Must Be Grounded in Verification

Potential next steps may include verification of property ownership and mineral rights, independent geological review and sampling, assessment of environmental and permitting obligations, infrastructure and processing-route analysis, and review of logistics, financing and transaction structure.

ELEKTROS intends to approach the opportunity through measured evaluation. Whether it proceeds will depend on the results of due diligence and management's assessment of the technical, regulatory, financial and commercial facts.

A Careful Approach to Long-Term Opportunities

The company values the continued interest of shareholders and others monitoring North American battery-material developments. ELEKTROS believes that potential opportunities should be evaluated carefully and that early-stage possibilities should not be confused with proven resources or operating projects.

Management expresses gratitude to Almighty God as the company works toward measurable progress. This release is provided solely for informational purposes and does not constitute an offer to sell securities or a recommendation to purchase ELEK shares.

ELEKTROS Inc. is publicly traded on the OTC market under ticker symbol ELEK. The company's areas of interest include hard-rock lithium opportunities, EV charging infrastructure and patented EV charging technology. The northern New York property discussed herein has not been acquired by ELEKTROS and is not a producing mine.

CyPath® Lung test unit sales double year to date over 2025, with solid gains in physician utilization and recurring orders; testing revenue increases 79% year-to-date

Company advances precision medicine pipeline with new asthma and COPD research, collaboration with Pictor and continued development of topical skin cancer therapeutics

SAN ANTONIO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: BIAF; BIAFW), a biotechnology company developing noninvasive healthcare solutions for the early detection and monitoring of lung disease and topically delivered therapeutics for skin cancer, today reported financial results and business highlights for the third quarter (Q3) ended September 30, 2026.

Q3 2026 Highlights and Recent Events

  • CyPath® Lung test unit sales increased 100% through Q3 compared to the first nine months of 2025.
  • CyPath Lung testing revenue for the first nine months of 2026 increased 79% to approximately $1.1 million, compared to the same period in 2025.
  • In July 2026, the Company surpassed the total number of CyPath Lung test reports delivered to physicians during 2025.
  • The number of ordering physicians increased by 89% in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter of 2025, continuing to expand clinical utilization of CyPath Lung. Physicians already ordering CyPath Lung tests increased their volume by 48% year over year.
  • The Company expanded its government healthcare distribution network and commercial reach through an agreement with AvMEDICAL, a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business and established distributor of medical-surgical and laboratory products and services to government agencies, including the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA).
  • The ongoing longitudinal clinical trial designed to evaluate the clinical performance of CyPath Lung continued to advance. As of September 30, 2026, 11 clinical sites were active, including nine VA and military medical centers that had begun patient enrollment. The John P. Murtha Cancer Center Research Program at the Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences is providing support and funding for the trial.
  • In July, the Company published a comprehensive clinical review and white paper authored by Chief Medical Officer Gordon H. Downie, MD, PhD, presenting a practical framework for incorporating CyPath Lung into pulmonology and oncology practices. Dr. Downie presented the framework to physicians in October at the annual meeting of the American College of Chest Physicians (CHEST 2026).
  • The Company advanced CyPath Lung for potential use in surveillance of lung cancer survivors as a complement to imaging to monitor patients for cancer recurrence and new primary lung cancers.
  • The Company presented positive research results at CHEST 2026 relating to its development of noninvasive tests to characterize lung inflammation and investigate biologic drug targets for asthma and COPD therapies. Further development and validation are underway to determine whether this approach can identify patients who may benefit from specific biologic therapies or support monitoring of lung inflammation over time.
  • The Company announced a collaboration with Pictor®, Inc., a targeted proteomic platform company, to support development and potential commercialization of bioAffinity Technologies’ next-generation diagnostic tests designed to provide a more complete picture of lung inflammation in patients with asthma and COPD.
  • The Company continued research into potential topically delivered therapeutics for squamous and basal cell skin cancers. Preliminary research findings have demonstrated that self-delivering, stabilized small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) selectively kill squamous and basal carcinoma cells in vitro while sparing noncancerous cutaneous cells.
  • In September, bioAffinity announced the grant of a Hong Kong patent covering CyPath Lung's proprietary flow cytometry + AI platform for predicting the likelihood of lung cancer by characterizing cell populations in sputum. In October, the Company received a Notice of Allowance from the Japan Patent Office indicating its intention to grant a patent for the method of predicting the likelihood of lung cancer used by the CyPath Lung test.
  • The Company raised an aggregate of $8.0 million in gross proceeds through a private placement offering in August 2026 and a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement in October 2026 for working capital and general corporate purposes, including support for the ongoing commercialization of CyPath Lung.

Management Commentary

"Our third-quarter results reflect CyPath Lung’s continued momentum in addressing the critical need for early lung cancer detection, driven by both new physicians ordering the test and increased use by existing customers. We believe this growth reflects increasing physician engagement and recognition of the role CyPath Lung can play in managing care for patients at risk for lung cancer. We are also advancing its potential use in surveillance following curative-intent treatment, where CyPath Lung could complement imaging in monitoring for recurrence and new cancers," said Maria Zannes, President of CEO of bioAffinity Technologies. "Peer-to-peer education and growing clinical experience with the test remain important drivers of adoption, while our longitudinal study is designed to generate robust, real-world data across multiple sites to further evaluate how CyPath Lung may support risk assessment and clinical decision-making. Together, these efforts advance our objective of establishing CyPath Lung as a standard of care for evaluating patients at risk for lung cancer.

"We continue to build the foundation for long-term growth. Beyond lung cancer, we are advancing our platform to take advantage of precision medicine opportunities in asthma and COPD, where sputum-based analysis may help characterize lung inflammation and help physicians better match individual patients to available treatments, including Tezspire, Dupixent and Nucala. The tests we are developing are designed to meet a critical need for precision diagnostics in the multi-billion-dollar asthma and COPD therapeutic markets.

"Our patent portfolio now includes 22 awarded U.S. and foreign patents and 36 pending applications. The recent Hong Kong patent and the Japanese patent allowance, once awarded, are important additions to our patent portfolio. Our distribution agreement with AvMEDICAL is intended to expand our reach into government healthcare markets, including the VA, where the substantial burden of lung cancer underscores the need for more effective ways to evaluate pulmonary nodules and improve patient outcomes.

Ms. Zannes concluded, "Our priorities remain disciplined execution, expanding commercial adoption and advancing our clinical and research programs. We are also pursuing topical therapeutic approaches for squamous and basal cell skin cancers based on promising findings involving the CD320 and LRP2 receptors. We believe our expertise in flow cytometry, automated data analysis and siRNA technology provides a foundation for developing differentiated products across these markets. Together, these programs demonstrate our commitment to translating scientific innovation into meaningful new opportunities for patients and the Company."

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

Total revenue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was approximately $1.1 million, compared with approximately $1.4 million for the same period in 2025. The decrease is due primarily to a decrease in average reimbursement per CyPath Lung test and a slight decline in total cases completed at Precision Pathology Laboratory Services (PPLS) compared to the same period in 2025, in part due to internal business changes at three PPLS research clients. Multiple accounts previously serviced under these clients have since returned to PPLS. The Company is working to restore additional accounts and improve reimbursement levels.

Net loss for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was approximately $5.3 million, compared with approximately $5.1 million for the third quarter of 2025. The increase in net loss is primarily due to the increase in loss from operations of approximately $3.5 million from approximately $2.3 million in the prior-year quarter, partially offset by a $1.2 million loss from the change in fair value of warrants, compared with a $2.7 million loss in the prior-year quarter.

Cash and cash equivalents were approximately $2.6 million as of September 30, 2026, compared with approximately $6.4 million at December 31, 2025. Subsequent to quarter-end, the Company completed a financing that generated approximately $4.0 million in gross proceeds.

Operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were approximately $4.6 million, compared with approximately $3.7 million in the third quarter of 2025.

  • Direct costs and expenses were approximately $1.1 million, compared with $942,000 in the prior-year period. The increase primarily reflected additional personnel to process CyPath Lung commercial tests and tests associated with the longitudinal clinical study.
  • Research and development expenses increased 18% year over year to approximately $389,000, primarily due to laboratory supplies and costs associated with relocating laboratory facilities in June 2026.
  • Clinical development expenses increased 75% to approximately $251,000, compared with approximately $143,000 in the third quarter of 2025. The increase primarily reflected the initiation of clinical trial sites and patient enrollment in the longitudinal clinical study.
  • Selling, general and administrative expenses increased 28% to approximately $2.8 million, compared with approximately $2.2 million in the prior-year period. The increase primarily reflected additional sales and marketing personnel and support services to expand commercialization of CyPath Lung.

About CyPath Lung

CyPath Lung by bioAffinity Technologies is a noninvasive test designed to improve the early detection of lung cancer in patients at high risk for the disease. CyPath Lung analyzes the lung microenvironment by using advanced flow cytometry and proprietary artificial intelligence (AI) to identify cell populations in patient sputum that indicate malignancy. The test incorporates a novel fluorescent porphyrin that is preferentially taken up by cancer and cancer-related cells. In a published clinical trial of high-risk patients, CyPath Lung demonstrated 92% sensitivity, 87% specificity, 88% accuracy and 99% negative predictive value (NPV) in detecting lung cancer in patients at high risk for the disease who had small indeterminate lung nodules less than 20 millimeters. The high NPV gives physicians greater confidence that a negative result is truly negative, potentially sparing patients from unnecessary invasive and costly procedures. CyPath Lung is marketed as a Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) and is not intended for use as a sole diagnostic tool and should be considered alongside other clinical findings. For more information, visit www.cypathlung.com.

About bioAffinity Technologies, Inc.

bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. addresses the need for noninvasive diagnosis of early-stage cancer and other diseases of the lung and broad-spectrum cancer treatments. The Company’s first product, CyPath Lung, is a noninvasive test that has shown high sensitivity, specificity and accuracy for the detection of early-stage lung cancer. CyPath Lung is marketed as a Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) by Precision Pathology Laboratory Services, a subsidiary of bioAffinity Technologies. LDTs are overseen under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA), which are administered by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. Key Terms

siRNAstechnical
Small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) are short strands of genetic material designed to bind and silence specific genes, like sending a targeted "mute" command to a particular instruction in a cell. Investors care because siRNA-based therapies can precisely treat diseases by turning off harmful genes, offering potential for strong clinical benefits and revenue but also carrying scientific, regulatory and manufacturing risks that affect a biotech company’s value.
flow cytometrytechnical
A laboratory method that uses lasers and sensors to count and analyze individual cells or tiny particles as they flow past a detector, like a high‑speed supermarket scanner that reads barcodes on each item. Investors care because flow cytometry is widely used in drug development, diagnostics and manufacturing quality control; demand for the instruments, reagents and services can signal progress in clinical programs, recurring revenue streams and adoption of new therapies or tests.
negative predictive valuemedical
Negative predictive value is a measure of how reliable a negative result is in confirming that a person or situation is truly free of a problem or condition. For investors, it indicates the likelihood that a negative signal or indicator truly means there is no risk or issue present, helping them assess how much trust to place in avoiding potential problems based on current information.
laboratory developed testregulatory
A laboratory developed test is a medical diagnostic created, validated and performed within a single clinical laboratory rather than sold as a boxed product to other labs or clinics. For investors, LDTs can offer faster product rollout and niche revenue streams like a custom service, but they also carry regulatory and reimbursement uncertainty and competitive risk—think of them as a handmade tool that can be quickly offered to customers but may face shifting rules or market limits.
clinical laboratory improvement amendmentsregulatory
A U.S. federal regulatory program that sets quality, certification, and inspection rules for laboratories that perform tests on human specimens to diagnose, prevent, or treat disease. It requires labs to meet standards for personnel, equipment, procedures, and result accuracy, and to obtain appropriate certificates before reporting patient results. It matters to investors because compliance affects a lab’s ability to operate, sell tests, and generate revenue, and can influence costs, inspection risk, reimbursement, and market access—similar to a licensing and safety-inspection system for labs.
registered direct offeringfinancial
A registered direct offering is a way for a company to sell new shares of its stock directly to select investors with regulatory approval. This method allows the company to raise funds quickly and efficiently without needing a public auction, similar to offering exclusive access to a limited number of buyers. For investors, it often provides an opportunity to purchase shares at a favorable price, while giving the company immediate access to capital.

NEW YORK, Nov. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TEN Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: XHLD), through its subsidiary, Ten Events, Inc., the technology company behind TEN, a Digital Experience Platform that powers the next generation of enterprise digital engagement, today announced its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

Management Commentary

"Third quarter revenue increased 17.9% year over year to $640,000, as we completed customer engagements that had been initiated in prior periods and added revenue from new customers," said Virgilio Torres, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of TEN Holdings. "Our performance reflects continued demand for our digital engagement solutions and our ability to serve both existing and new customers. As we look ahead, our focus remains on expanding recurring revenue, strengthening our technology platform, and accelerating our transition toward a scalable, SaaS-driven business model."

"Our third-quarter results reflect two significant expenses that we consider non-recurring: a $1.8 million write-off of previously capitalized service contracts and approximately $0.5 million in legal expenses. Excluding these items, our underlying selling, general and administrative expenses declined compared to the same period last year, reflecting the progress we have made in improving operational efficiency. Over the past 12 months, we have reduced our annual operating cost structure by approximately $2.5 million through strategic cost reductions, process improvements, and the integration of AI-driven tools to streamline engineering and accelerate product development. With these efficiencies largely implemented and a leaner operating structure in place, we are now shifting our focus toward accelerating revenue growth, expanding customer relationships, and scaling TEN, our new platform."

"We also made significant progress in strengthening our balance sheet, reducing short-term related-party borrowings from $4.6 million at the beginning of the year to approximately $0.1 million as of September 30, 2026. Total liabilities declined by approximately 74%, from $7.7 million at year-end 2025 to $2.0 million, reflecting our continued efforts to simplify our capital structure and improve our financial position."

"One of our most significant milestones this year was the launch of TEN, our next-generation Digital Experience Platform, whose development was accelerated by investments made possible through the proceeds of our June common stock offering, consistent with our previously communicated commitment to product development. TEN represents an important step in our evolution toward a scalable, SaaS-driven business model, bringing together the tools organizations need to create, manage, deliver, and measure digital experiences within a unified platform.

At launch, TEN provides enterprises with a self-service solution for webinars, virtual events, and continuing education programs, with the capacity to support up to 50,000 concurrent attendees. Building on our longstanding relationships with enterprise customers, many of whom rely on our technology for recurring digital engagement initiatives, we see a meaningful opportunity to transition these relationships toward subscription-based arrangements. We believe this approach will deliver greater flexibility and value to our customers while creating a more predictable and recurring revenue stream for TEN Holdings."

"Looking ahead, we are focused on three priorities: continuing the transition of our business from a managed services provider to a SaaS company, investing in TEN so that it remains competitive, and executing an acquisition strategy aimed at accretive businesses that add revenue and EBITDA, products our sales team can scale, and technology that complements our own. With TEN now in the market, a leaner cost structure, and a simplified balance sheet, we believe TEN Holdings is positioned to build a more scalable, recurring revenue business and create long-term value for our shareholders."

Financial Results

  • Revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $640,000, a $97,000 or 17.9% increase compared to revenue of $543,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase was primarily driven by the completion of customer transactions initiated in prior periods, along with revenue contributions from new customers acquired during the current period.
    • Platform usage revenue decreased by $63,000, or 12.8%, to $428,000.
    • Professional and managed services revenue increased by $160,000, or 307.7%, to $212,000.
  • Cost of revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $261,000, a $123,000 or 89.1% increase compared to $138,000 for the same period in 2025. The increase was primarily due to a higher number of on-site events held during the quarter compared to the same period last year. Gross profit was $379,000, compared to $405,000, and gross profit margin was 59.2%, compared to 74.6% in the prior-year period.
  • Selling, general and administrative ("SG&A") expenses were $4,113,000, a $1,928,000 or 88.2% increase compared to SG&A expenses of $2,185,000 for the same period last year. The increase was primarily driven by a $1.8 million write-off of previously capitalized service contracts that had been subject to amortization, as well as approximately $0.5 million in legal expenses related to ongoing litigation. Excluding these expenses, SG&A expenses would have decreased by approximately $0.4 million, or approximately 18%, compared to the prior-year period. Third quarter 2026 SG&A also included an approximately $0.3 million reduction in expense resulting from the reversal of previously recognized stock-based compensation associated with forfeited awards.
  • Depreciation and amortization expense decreased to $10,000 from $147,000 in the prior-year period, primarily because the Company's capitalized software was fully impaired during 2025 and no software assets were subject to amortization during the quarter.
  • Interest expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026 totaled $2,000, compared to $59,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease was primarily due to a lower outstanding short-term loan balance.
  • Net loss for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $3,734,000, or $(0.31) per share, a $1,747,000 or 87.9% increase compared to a net loss of $1,987,000, or $(0.84) per share, for the same period in 2025. The increase in net loss was primarily driven by the higher SG&A expenses described above, including the write-off and legal expenses.
  • Weighted average number of common shares outstanding was 11,999,366 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to 2,359,622 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Share and per share amounts for prior periods reflect the Company's 1-for-15 reverse stock split, which became effective on December 1, 2025.

Selected Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Results

  • As of September 30, 2026, the Company had cash and cash equivalents of $3.5 million, plus $0.1 million of restricted cash, compared to $1.6 million as of December 31, 2025, and $0.3 million as of September 30, 2025. The increase from year-end was primarily driven by the gross proceeds of the Company's $7.5 million common stock offering, which closed on June 30, 2026, partially offset by cash used in operating activities. Compared to $5.8 million as of June 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents decreased by $2.3 million, primarily reflecting $2.7 million of cash used in operating activities during the third quarter, partially offset by $0.7 million in proceeds from the exercise of stock options.
  • Short-term loans from related parties declined to $0.1 million as of September 30, 2026, from $4.6 million as of December 31, 2025, primarily reflecting the settlement of $4.6 million of debt through offsetting against a receivable due from a related party, as well as cash repayments. Total liabilities declined to $2.0 million from $7.7 million at December 31, 2025.
  • Net cash used in operating activities was $5.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $9.0 million during the same period of 2025. The decrease was primarily attributable to the absence of $4.7 million in advances to related parties made during the prior-year period, partially offset by a $2.9 million decrease in non-cash stock-based compensation expense and the absence of a $1.3 million non-cash loss on extinguishment of debt recognized in the prior-year period.
  • Net cash used in investing activities was zero for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $0.8 million during the same period of 2025, due to the absence of expenditures for capitalized internal-use software.
  • Net cash provided by financing activities was $7.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $10.1 million during the same period of 2025. The decrease was primarily attributable to lower proceeds from the issuance of shares and lower related-party loan proceeds received in the prior-year period, partially offset by lower repayments of related-party loans and $0.7 million in proceeds from the exercise of stock options.

Recent Corporate Highlights

  • During the third quarter, holders exercised stock options to purchase 89,405 shares of common stock, providing the Company with aggregate cash proceeds of approximately $0.73 million.
  • Launched TEN, the Company's new Digital Experience Platform, which combines registration, live production, audience engagement, on-demand content, and continuing education credentialing in a single system, available on a self-service basis or with managed services as an add-on.
  • Appointed Ian M. Lawson as Interim Chief Financial Officer, effective September 30, 2026.
  • Relocated the Company's headquarters to New York, New York.
  • Filed a registration statement on Form S-3 for a $100 million universal shelf.
  • Completed the termination of certain agreements entered into by former management in connection with the Company's initial public offering, as disclosed in the Company's Form 8-K filed on July 24, 2026.

Company Outlook

Mr. Torres added that TEN Holdings plans to:

  • Continue transitioning its business from a managed services model to a recurring, subscription-based SaaS model built on TEN, while continuing to offer white-glove managed production services for customers who want them.
  • Expand TEN beyond events and webinars, including AI and automation, integrations, engagement and intent, reporting and analytics, and content studio capabilities.
  • Pursue disciplined acquisitions of accretive businesses that add revenue and EBITDA, products the Company's sales team can scale, and technologies that complement its existing intellectual property, as part of a broader consolidation strategy.

About TEN Holdings, Inc.

TEN Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: XHLD) is a New York-based technology company focused on developing enterprise software solutions that enable organizations to create, manage, deliver, and measure digital experiences. Through its flagship Digital Experience Platform, TEN, the Company provides technology solutions for enterprise communications, virtual events, webinars, and continuing education, supporting digital experiences with up to 50,000 concurrent attendees.

Building on more than a decade of experience serving Fortune 500 companies, TEN Holdings is evolving its platform into a broader, AI-enabled enterprise technology ecosystem. Its product roadmap includes marketing automation, CRM integrations, advanced engagement analytics, AI-powered capabilities, and content management solutions designed to help organizations streamline workflows, strengthen customer engagement, and generate actionable business insights.

The Company's strategy is centered on expanding its SaaS offerings, increasing recurring revenue opportunities, and delivering scalable technology solutions to enterprise customers. Planned capabilities remain subject to ongoing development, and there can be no assurance regarding their timing or availability.

WEST PALM BEACH, FL / ACCESS Newswire / November 6, 2026 / Looking Closer to Home for Lithium Potential

Lithium has become an important material in the evolving electric-vehicle and energy-storage industries. As manufacturers and supply-chain participants assess the future availability of battery materials, potential sources located in the United States continue to draw attention.

ELEKTROS Inc. (OTC PINK:ELEK), a publicly traded company, is evaluating a potential hard-rock lithium opportunity in northern New York near the Canadian border. The review is preliminary and exploratory. ELEKTROS has not completed or announced an acquisition of the property, and no independently verified mineral resource, mineral reserve or economic development case has been established.

Why a Domestic Opportunity Deserves a Closer Look

If the property's geology, mineral rights, infrastructure, permitting pathway and economics ultimately prove supportive, a viable operation could potentially contribute to a domestic supply option for participants in the battery-material chain. A U.S.-based source could also, in principle, reduce reliance on overseas ocean transport and certain international customs procedures.

Those possibilities remain matters for investigation-not established project advantages. Further work is required to determine whether lithium is present in commercially meaningful quantities and whether development would be practical, permissible and financially supportable.

A Market at an Important Crossroads

Benzinga's October 22, 2026 article, "Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat," referenced a Benchmark Mineral Intelligence outlook projecting that global lithium demand could more than triple by 2050. The outlook described a possible need for 134 new mines and more than $100 billion in investment, with electric-vehicle batteries and stationary energy storage contributing to demand.

These broad industry estimates are not forecasts for ELEKTROS and do not establish the quality, scale or value of the northern New York property. The cited article discussed companies other than ELEKTROS.

EV Charging Technology: A Separate Area of Focus

ELEKTROS is also exploring potential development relationships concerning its multi-port electric-vehicle charging patent, U.S. Patent No. 12,522,100 B1. The company views its charging-technology initiative and its review of lithium opportunities as separate activities within its longer-term areas of interest.

The company is not announcing a completed prototype, patent license, customer deployment, adoption milestone or revenue associated with the patent.

From Possibility to Evidence

Further evaluation of the northern New York possibility may include confirming ownership and mineral rights; obtaining independent geological analysis and sampling; reviewing environmental and permitting requirements; assessing infrastructure and potential processing routes; and evaluating logistics, financing and transaction structure.

Management believes disciplined due diligence is essential before making commitments. Any decision to advance the opportunity will depend on the evidence gathered and management's assessment of technical, regulatory, financial and commercial considerations.

Commitment to Measured Progress

ELEKTROS appreciates the continued engagement of its shareholders and those following developments in North American lithium. The company intends to continue identifying and assessing opportunities while recognizing that early-stage concepts require careful validation before they can be characterized as viable projects.

Management expresses gratitude to Almighty God as the company works toward measurable progress. This release is for informational purposes only and does not constitute an offer to sell securities or a recommendation to purchase ELEK shares.

About ELEKTROS Inc.
